claims: - **CH4 and CO2.** Solid CH4 creeps with exponent 1.9 ± 0.2 and an effective viscosity of 1e11 Pa s at 0.1 MPa and 77 K. Solid CO2 deforms brittly at 77 K (Yamashita et al. 1997).
**Sources.** Umurhan et al. 2017 (READ, full text); Yamashita et al. 2010 (FOUND); Yamashita et al. 1997 (FOUND); Bertrand et al. 2018 (READ); Stern et al. 2026 (READ).
